paper.title: Towards minimax policies for online linear optimization with bandit feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Online linear optimization with bandit feedback, finite action set of N actions

settings.definition_quote: In this paper we are interested in the dual setting, where the adversary plays on a dual action set, i.e., $\cA$ and $\cZ$ are such that $|a^{\top} z| \leq 1, \forall (a,z) \in \cA \times \cZ$.

source.label: th:exp2john
source.quote: {\sc exp2} with John's exploration and estimate \eqref{eq:banditestimate} satisfies, for $\frac{\eta d}{\gamma} \leq 1$, $$R_n \leq 2 \gamma n + \frac{\log N}{\eta} + \eta n d.$$

results.notes: N = number of actions mapped to K. Regret defined as E sum a_t^T z_t - min_a E sum a^T z_t. Compute: per-round cost linear in N; John's ellipsoid approximable in poly time for finite sets.

source.label: th:hypercube
source.quote: Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA$ with regularizer~(\ref{eq:entro-reg}) satisfies, for any $\eta$ and $\gamma \in (0,1)$ such that $\frac{\eta d}{\gamma} \leq \frac12$, ... In particular, with $\gamma = 2 d \sqrt{\frac{\log 2}{3 n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log 2}{3 n}}$, $R_n \leq 2 d \sqrt{3 n \log 2}$.

results.notes: Computational complexity linear in d per paper. General bound (eq. hypercuberegret1) involves algorithm-dependent quantities and is not recorded separately.

source.label: th:ball
source.quote: Then {\sc osmd} on $\cA' = \{x \in \R^d: \|x\| \leq 1-\gamma \}$ with the estimate \eqref{eq:ballestimate}, and $F(x) = - \log (1 - \|x\|) - \|x\|$ satisfies, for any $\eta$ such that $\eta d \leq \frac12$, ... In particular, with $\gamma = \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$ and $\eta= \sqrt{\frac{\log n}{2 n d}}$, $R_n \leq  3 \sqrt{d n \log n}$.

results.notes: Tuned eta*d <= 1/2 holds implicitly for n large enough relative to d.
